english.title: Fail to surrender an authority under section 5 of the Firearms Act 1968 within 21 days of the notice
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been given notice in writing by the

(A)_[Secretary of State]_
(B)_[Scottish Ministers]_

on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE OF NOTICE..) that the authority given to you under section 5 of the Firearms Act 1968, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..), had been revoked, you failed to deliver up that authority to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) as specified in the notice within twenty-one days from the date of the notice
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(6) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968.

english.notes: On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).
